Subject: Request: MSA redline live review and procurement evidence run-through

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the time last week. Oakleaf Legal and Procurement would like to run a short live session to walk through the current MSA redlines and confirm the evidence bundle we need to move the PO through. High level asks:

- Live review of our redline (20–30m) to call out any must-fix language for procurement.
- Quick evidence run-through (15m) — what you can provide pre-call vs. what we need during kickoff.
- Confirm signing / PO timing assumptions.

Would you be available for a 45-minute slot this week or early next week? Suggested attendees from our side: Lina Gomez (Legal), Marcus Lee (IT Security), and Procurement (procurement@oakleaf.io). We can share our internal authorization note ahead of time.

Attachments: Oakleaf-Evidence-Checklist.pdf (pdf) — internal reference.

Thanks,
Evan

Hi Evan —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can run a focused 45-minute session and pull the right folks. Quick availability (all times PT):

- Tue 2027-05-04: 10:00–10:45 or 14:00–14:45
- Wed 2027-05-05: 09:30–10:15 or 15:00–15:45
- Thu 2027-05-06: 11:00–11:45 (limited)

If any of those work, tell me which slot and I’ll send an invite with a short agenda. For the call we propose: 1) 20m redline live review (legal + Diego + Kimberly), 2) 15m evidence checklist (Marissa + SRE/ops), 3) 10m procurement Q&A / next steps.

To help Oakleaf prepare, I’m attaching our standard evidence bundle checklist. We’ll publish a pre-read folder with copies of: SOC 2 Type II (redacted), data-retention runbook excerpt, KMS integration notes, and the hosting architecture diagram. If Oakleaf needs anything beyond that (e.g., network allowlist procedure), flag it and we’ll add it to the bundle.

Attachments: Redwood-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Cc’ing Marissa and Kimberly to confirm the artifacts and who on our side will present each section. Also looping in Rishi for any technical clarifications on the KMS/keys side.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
